meanings_en: public position or attitude (as opposed to private thoughts)

examples.ja: アメリカも本音と建前を使い分ける国だ。
examples.en: America is also a country that separates its public motives from its private ones.

examples.ja: 少数民族の雇用促進政策とはいっても、建前にすぎず、現状はマイノリティーが職に就けるチャンスなどほとんどない。
examples.en: Although many pay lip service to the idea of affirmative action, in reality, very few minorities get hired.
